text2midi.implementation: Official Transformer.generate; torch.inference_mode; float32; no sampling changes
text2midi.encoder_initialization: Architecture from pinned FLAN-T5 config; complete encoder weights required in the Text2midi checkpoint via strict state-dict load

samples.prompt: A gentle expressive solo acoustic grand piano piece in C major, 4/4 time, at a slow tempo of 64 beats per minute. A sparse lyrical right-hand melody floats above soft left-hand broken chords and arpeggios. Calm, intimate, warm and reflective, with quiet dynamics and breathing space between phrases. Piano is the only instrument. No drums, no percussion, no other instruments. Approximately one minute long.

A quiet and tender solo acoustic grand piano composition in A minor, 4/4 time, at 68 beats per minute. A simple singing melody with expressive phrasing and gentle arpeggiated accompaniment. Soft dynamics, spacious phrases, a peaceful reflective mood and a resolved ending. Piano alone, without drums, percussion or any other instrument. About one minute long.

implementation_audit.inference_changes: inference_mode only; complete strict checkpoint loading; no modified sampling
implementation_audit.finding: No model/tokenizer/architecture mismatch found. Both fixed-seed generations failed requested solo-piano instrumentation.

transformations: Map remaining program changes to acoustic grand piano program0

renderer_timing_verification.method: Compare mido tempo-map seconds of last note-off to sfizz --use-eot output; require <=one audio block error and bit-identical normal-render prefix.
renderer_timing_verification.finding: sfizz/fmidi event playback ends at last playable event, ignoring trailing EndOfTrack silence. Default rendering then appends a natural sample decay until mean-square power falls below1e-12. No tempo-map flattening needed.
